values.purpose: Applications are collected and reviewed in an online portal, and shortlisted applicants are invited to interviews.

risks: Weak passwords on the vendor portal

values.activity: Video surveillance of the warehouse entrance
values.purpose: Cameras at the warehouse entrance record who enters outside opening hours, to prevent theft and to investigate incidents.
values.data_categories: Video images of employees, drivers and visitors
values.legal_basis: Article 6(1)(e) GDPR – task in the public interest
risks: Weak passwords on the vendor portal
Transfer to a processor outside the EEA
Standard contractual clauses and a transfer assessment
Automatic deletion when the retention period ends

values.purpose: Working hours are recorded per employee to pay overtime correctly, to plan shifts and to meet the legal duty to record working time.
values.data_categories: Names, staff numbers, working hours and absence types
values.legal_basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR – performance of a contract
risks: Weak passwords on the vendor portal
Automatic deletion when the retention period ends
Purpose recorded in the record of processing activities
Privacy notice linked in every form

values.purpose: Subscribers receive a monthly newsletter, and opening rates are measured to choose the topics readers find useful.
values.data_categories: E-mail addresses, subscription dates and opening statistics
risks: Purpose recorded in the record of processing activities
Automatic deletion when the retention period ends

values.purpose: Customers are asked to rate the service after a project closes, and the answers are used to improve the service.
values.data_categories: Names, e-mail addresses, ratings and free-text comments
values.legal_basis: Article 9(2)(b) GDPR – employment and social security
risks: Transfer to a processor outside the EEA
Standard contractual clauses and a transfer assessment
Wrong data leads to wrong decisions
Checks at entry and a correction process
Loss of a laptop with exported data
Full-disk encryption and no local exports

values.summary: Progress was slower than planned because two team members were absent. The critical path is not affected yet, but the buffer is down to three days.
values.risks: The interface partner has not confirmed the test window; if it slips, go-live moves by a week.

values.summary: User feedback from the pilot was positive. The rollout to the remaining sites will start once the last open defect is fixed.
values.risks: Two open defects block the sign-off; the vendor has promised fixes for the next release.

values.summary: The vendor delivered the second release late, which used up the buffer in the plan. The team is re-planning the training sessions around the new date.
values.risks: The budget reserve is almost used up, so any new change request needs funding first.

values.summary: Licence costs came in higher than budgeted. The steering committee will decide next week whether to reduce the scope or to release the reserve.
values.risks: The training material is not translated yet, which could delay the rollout abroad.

values.summary: All workstreams are on schedule. The data protection review is complete, and the first users will be migrated at the start of the next period.
values.risks: The legacy system's support contract ends in June, which leaves no room for delays.
